segments.mil7.8.1:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘kumbhassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban”ti?
segments.mil7.8.1:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, kumbho sampuṇṇo na saṇati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena āgame adhigame pariyattiyaṃ sāmaññe pāramiṃ patvā na saṇitabbaṃ, na tena māno karaṇīyo, na dabbo [dappo (sī.)] dassetabbo, nihatamānena nihatadabbena bhavitabbaṃ, ujukena amukharena avikatthinā.
segments.mil7.8.1:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, kumbhassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
